title: HTTPS handshake failures while payment tasks stay RUNNING
customerImpact: Merchants fail HTTPS to payments.apps.baypay.example; POST /api/v1/payments never leaves the client; ECS tasks remain RUNNING

gates.instruction: Read this timeline and the handshake paste before requesting ACM describe.

gates.instruction: Open the Route 53 record list only after you write what DNS names the edge or certificate workflow would need.

events.name: Jordan Voss
events.summary: Ticket BAYPAY-14021 with Sam Okada: cleaned unused records in the baypay.example hosted zone so the zone 'only has what merchants hit.' Change merged the same afternoon.

events.name: Sam Okada
events.summary: Confirmed the public ALIAS for payments.apps.baypay.example still pointed at the us-west-2 ALB after the cleanup. Said leftover names that 'nothing resolved' were removed.
Leaf presented on payments.apps.baypay.example :443 reached its notAfter (see handshake paste). No page fired overnight.
SEV-2: payments.apps.baypay.example HTTPS failures. Harbor Market cannot complete the handshake. payment-service tasks RUNNING in baypay-prod-west.
Harbor Market: Avery Chen payment c1402b22-0000-4000-8000-111111111402 never left the browser. Same Idempotency-Key on retry. Certificate / handshake warning. No HTTP status from Spring.

events.name: Priya Nair
events.summary: Tasks RUNNING 2/2. Jump-box HTTP to task :8080 /actuator/health/liveness returns 200. Asked for the client handshake before blaming the security group or Postgres.

events.name: Riley Okonkwo
events.summary: Requested handshake paste (gate 1). Told Sam not to disable TLS on the ALB to 'restore HTTP' and not to bounce dmgr-east. Asked what ACM shows for the payments host after the August DNS cleanup.
